description: Buffer is a social media publishing platform that lets people and teams schedule posts, manage content ideas, and coordinate publishing across connected social channels. Its API and related tools operate on a user's Buffer account and organizations.
summary: Buffer exposes a GraphQL API at api.buffer.com, an MCP server at mcp.buffer.com, a terminal CLI (`buffer`), and a legacy REST API at api.bufferapp.com; auth is via Buffer-issued API keys and/or OAuth depending on the surface.
